# Manual cc1plus profile coverage

The opt-in profile is a set of separate passes on the **same runner**, not one all-enabled elapsed time. A pass is a nonempty measured result validated by its collector, not presence of an option, a file, or a sample with a name. Caller writes JSON with a `lanes` object keyed by the IDs below, each with `status` in `pass,partial,not_run,unavailable,fail`. Run `python3 -B coverage.py REPORT.json`. Missing is `not_run`; any required non-pass yields exit 2. Set `target:"inline_only"` only to report an explicitly scoped Node-inline run; it never substitutes for a Worker pass. Default requires both. The validator emits only enums; use a separate allowlist for numerical aggregates and retain reviewer details solely in runner scratch. This validates the state envelope, not the collectors' proof.

| Lane(s) | Required evidence for pass |
|---|---|
| matched_closure | Immutable source/pins/ELF/build IDs, argv/env/cwd/ABI, root and layer digests, actual stage paths from same runner; hashes/metadata of actual immutable closure read through independent native extraction and Sods layer reader. |
| semantic_artifact_wait | Real Ninja -j1 proof; edit changes TU object and linked proof's result; unchanged driver reused; native/Sods artifact bytes and terminal wait match; real assembler/link and early failure observed. No output cache or last-console endpoint. |
| stock_cold_abba / stock_warm_abba | Uninstrumented paired, alternating ABBA native/Sods trials. Cold uses source edit over verified pre-edit state with fresh engine; first build of A is not cold A→B. Warm uses validated priming and a real A→B. Disclose independent engine/cache/host-cache states, per-pair signed delta and uncertainty. Whole wall from immediately before invocation through matching parent wait, not summing disjoint medians. |
| paired_semantic_phases | Exact same-meaning/causal start/end anchors validated on both builds, endpoints and signed reconciliation through terminal wait; missing/mismatched branches unresolved. Adaptive split tracks both positive children and negative offsets; no midpoint by time. |
| native_function_samples / sods_function_samples | Source/image identity and executing phase; physical/inline policy stated; disjoint top self samples plus unknown count and coverage, one denominator per lane. Sods script bytes must independently bind actual prepared-Wasm digest, function body/ELF VMA and module/instance generation; name, script URL or PID alone insufficient. Samples are not CPU milliseconds or instruction counts. |
| paired_function_self_cpu / paired_function_inclusive_cpu | Distinct verified call-boundary diagnostic including same thread on-CPU deltas, paired entry/exit, recursive/tail/exceptions behavior and explicit unclassified gaps. Self excludes child CPU; inclusive is per call/nonadditive across tree. Sampling-based estimates stay partial, never relabeled exact. Remove diagnostic probes on stock timing. |
| paired_function_call_counts | Validated entry/call-site mapping, separate recursive, inline/tail, throw and unmatched counts. No derivation from top stack samples. |
| native_ir / guest_x86_ir / host_translated_ir | Same ELF native retired or explicitly labeled emulator instruction count; separate dynamically executed guest x86 count with original decoder/x86 address ownership and fault handling; separate host generated-code retired instruction count with live JIT address/safepoint identities. Do not equate Callgrind Ir, hardware retirees, Wasm opcodes or JIT size; report unmatched code, imports, VM/runtime and loss. Generic PMU whole-process count alone does not qualify as translated host Ir. |
| native_perf | Stock kernel event availability/validation on chosen runner, bounded lost/multiplexed records and released scope; no lowering perf/ptrace restrictions. A permission denial is unavailable, not zero. |
| v8_main_scopes / v8_background_tier | Actual foreground JIT/GC on selected TID only, nonoverlap with runtime/I/O; distinguish background compile interval, tier/birth and link to live code/owner, overlap separately. Code publication is not retire or duration. |
| syscall_fs / scheduler_wait_deschedule | Verified operation/path class/count/bytes, synchronous duration vs blocked wait; actual scheduler trace or proved wait transitions, child runnable vs parent blocked, host deschedule vs I/O. Wall minus CPU does not qualify. |
| memory_ownership_highwater / kernel_faults | Perturbation-labeled run covering unique live input, VFS/Wasm, transient buffers, translator arena, host RSS, JIT/code storage, high-water/phase and overlap; separately measured major/minor host and guest semantics with process ownership. RSS subtraction is not provenance. |
| worker_lane | Independent intended Worker deployment/backend and workload verification including queue/transfers/shared waits and worker lifetimes; Node inline does not count. Explicitly out-of-target only for inline-only label. |

Check ordinary GH runner permissions (perf events, scheduler tracing, ptrace) with no policy changes and leave unsupported cases explicit. Package/root cache hit, historical other-toolchain output, test fixture, or aggregate/report format success is not any missing live lane. Module/root, raw trace, profiles, paths, paths embedded in diagnostics and build stdout stay in runner scratch; public log receives fixed IDs/status and only reviewed scalar summaries.
